The 100 mm dimension [D19] has no specific tolerance indicated, so the general tolerance applies per IS 2102 as noted in the title block [TB:general_tolerance_standard].

For a 100 mm linear dimension (range "over 30 up to 120"), the drawing’s printed general-tolerance table gives ±0.3 mm for machining [T:is2102 linear 100], which matches the medium class value of 0.3 mm [T:is2102 linear 100]. Since this is a machining drawing [TB:drawing_type], the applicable tolerance is ±0.3 mm.
